note: 25/11 (daily run, 2nd step): NEW hypothesis written AFTER s15-cluster/-new, where the control 'only c>=3' (c = coins whose star trade enters at the same 4h bar in the same direction) beat the star on train in BOTH universes (102 coins: PF 1.39 vs 1.30; other 103: 1.24 vs 1.16) and skipping clusters hurt — the opposite of the original hypothesis. Because the idea came from looking at those results, it is tested here on a THIRD universe never used for it: the 120 archive coins of s15-newcoins (where the star itself failed test, PF 0.96). Rows fixed now: only c>=2 / >=3 / >=4. Accept 'only c>=3' only if on these coins it beats the star PF on train AND test, test PF>1.1, fresh not losing, and the neighbours c>=2 and c>=4 also beat the star on train. Caveat: with 10 slots, part of the effect may be slot dynamics.
